These instructions explain how to connect to the **Orchard** server from a Windows PC or Mac.

## Before you begin

You will need:

- A CSU NetID and password
- Access to Duo two-factor authentication
- Permission to access the Orchard server
- An internet connection

If you are off campus, connect to CSU's **GlobalProtect VPN** before opening the remote desktop application. Instructions for installing and using GlobalProtect are available on the [CSU GlobalProtect VPN website](https://csusystem.freshservice.com/support/solutions/folders/23000047198). 

::: {.callout-note}
## Login information

- **Server:** `Orchard.cas.colostate.edu`
- **Username:** `COLOSTATE\YourNetID`
- **Password:** Your CSU NetID password

Replace `YourNetID` with your own NetID. Do not share or email your password.
:::

## Windows PC

Windows computers include the **Remote Desktop Connection** application.

### Set up the connection

1. Open the Windows **Start** menu.
2. Search for **Remote Desktop Connection** and open it.
3. Select **Show Options**.
4. In the **Computer** field, enter:

   ```text
   Orchard.cas.colostate.edu
   ```

5. In the **User name** field, enter `COLOSTATE\YourNetID`.

<!-- Suggested screenshot: Remote Desktop Connection > General tab with the Computer and User name fields completed. -->

### Make your local drives available on Orchard

This setting allows you to open files from or save files to your own computer while working on Orchard. **You will only need to set this up once.**

1. In **Remote Desktop Connection**, select **Show Options** to expand window.
2. Navigate to the **Local Resources** tab.
3. Under **Local devices and resources**, select **More...**.
4. Mark the checkbox next to **Drives**.
5. Select **OK**.
6. Return to the **General** tab.

<!-- Suggested screenshot: Local Resources > More with Drives checked. -->

After you log in, your local drives should appear in **File Explorer** under **This PC**. They may be labeled with names such as `C on YourComputerName`.

::: {.callout-caution}
Files opened from Orchard may be saved to the redirected drive on your local computer.
:::

### Connect

1. Select **Connect**.
2. When prompted for your password, enter your CSU NetID password.

You should now see the Windows desktop for Orchard.

## Mac

Mac users will connect through Microsoft's **Windows App**, which replaced the former Microsoft Remote Desktop app.

### Install Windows App

1. Open the **App Store** on your Mac.
2. Search for **Windows App** by Microsoft Corporation.
3. Install and open the app.

You can also access the official download through [Microsoft's Windows App instructions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-app/get-started-connect-devices-desktops-apps#connect-to-a-remote-pc).

### Add Orchard

1. Open **Windows App** and select the **Devices** tab.
2. Select the **+** icon, then choose **Add PC**.
3. In **PC Name**, enter:

   ```text
   Orchard.cas.colostate.edu
   ```

4. If you want to save your username, add a user account using `COLOSTATE\YourNetID`. You may also leave the account setting as **Ask when required**.
5. Optional: enter **Orchard** as the friendly name.
6. Select **Add**.

<!-- Suggested screenshot: Windows App > Add PC with the Orchard server name entered. -->

### Make a folder on your Mac available on Orchard

Folder redirection allows you to open files from or save files to a selected folder on your Mac while working on Orchard. **You will only need to set this up once.**

1. In the **Devices** tab, find the Orchard connection.
2. Select the **...** menu on the Orchard card, then select **Edit**.
3. Open the **Folders** tab.
4. Mark **Redirect folders**, then select the **+** icon.
5. Choose the folder you want to make available on Orchard.
6. Select **Save**.

<!-- Suggested screenshot: Windows App > Edit > Folders with Redirect folders enabled. -->

The redirected folder should appear as a network drive in **File Explorer** during your Orchard session. If macOS asks whether Windows App may access files or folders, select **Allow** for the folder you chose.

::: {.callout-caution}
Files opened from Orchard may be saved to the redirected drive on your local computer.
:::

### Connect

1. Double-click the **Orchard** connection in the **Devices** tab.
2. When prompted, enter `COLOSTATE\YourNetID` and your CSU NetID password.
3. Complete Duo authentication if prompted.
4. If a certificate or identity message appears, confirm that the computer name is `Orchard.cas.colostate.edu`. If a different computer is listed, cancel the connection and ask for help.

You should now see the Windows desktop for Orchard.

## After your first successful login

Once you have successfully connected to Orchard, notify Dr. Chenarides. We will schedule a time to meet with **Alex in IT** to activate and connect your Microsoft 365 account on the server.

::: {.callout-important}
Please confirm that you can reach the Orchard desktop before the meeting with Alex. Do not try to configure Microsoft 365 on the server on your own.
:::

## Ending your session

Save your work before ending the session. When you are finished:

1. On Orchard, open the Windows **Start** menu.
2. Select your user icon.
3. Select **Sign out**.

Closing the remote desktop window only disconnects the session and may leave applications running on the server. Sign out when you are finished unless you have been instructed to leave a process running.
